crossRefs.note: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”
Yahweh’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but only the word that I shall speak to you, that you shall speak.” So…
I will raise them up a prophet from among their brothers, like you. I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall…
The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
I have put my words in your mouth and have covered you in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay…
“As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says Yahweh. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in…
Then Yahweh stretched out his hand, and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your…
for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”
Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: Yahweh put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
translations.bsb: Then the LORD put a message in Balaam’s mouth, saying, “Return to Balak and give him this message.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
translations.asv: And Jehovah put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
